user.title: Connect Duracell Energy Cloud
user.description: Enter your Duracell monitoring account credentials. Your sites and supported hybrid inverters will be discovered automatically.

details.title: Configure inverter monitoring
details.description: Enter the inverter's serial/JSON key, GroupAutoID and the per-operation sign values observed in your own browser's Network tab. Login signature and flowgraph signature are different. This integration reads data only.

select_inverter.title: Select your inverter
select_inverter.description: Choose the inverter to connect. Add the integration again to connect another inverter.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your username and password. If the portal requires a CAPTCHA, sign in there first before retrying.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read your account or inverter. Check the monitoring portal and try again.
error.missing_fields: Inverter ID, GroupAutoID and flowgraph signature are required.
error.no_inverters: No supported hybrid inverters were found on this account.

abort.wrong_inverter: Use the same inverter ID as the existing integration.
